evidence_for: Drive current revision id is observed as 2 and previous revision id as 1.
Drive revision 2 text/plain content was read in this cycle.
GitHub bootstrap blob identity is observed as 2fdb05b786f1d42db12182bc4e7023a28499cb46 and its text was read in this cycle.
Substantive bootstrap headings, policies, authority model, pointers, custody rules and F_ok/F_gap/F_next contract are semantically aligned in the scoped reads.
failure_mode: Semantic mirror could be mistaken for cryptographic identity when Drive export representation and GitHub Markdown bytes are not bound by one shared digest/canonicalization receipt.
falsifier: A shared canonicalization-and-digest procedure yields different digests, or a material semantic divergence is observed between the referenced Drive revision and GitHub blob.
next_probe: Export both representations under one explicit canonicalization contract, hash both outputs, compare digests, and append the terminal parity receipt.

mitigation.current_use: Use semantic alignment for routing only.
mitigation.forbidden_promotion: Do not claim byte identity until a common digest comparison exists.
mitigation.rollback: Retain the predecessor TOKEN_VAZIO state if any material divergence is found.

closure_gate.criterion: Drive revision identity, GitHub blob identity, shared canonicalized digests and comparison result are bound in one receipt.
closure_gate.evidence_needed: Drive revision/export digest + GitHub canonicalized digest + canonicalization contract + comparison result.
closure_gate.falsifier: Digest mismatch or material semantic divergence.

review_or_expiry: Revalidate after any material bootstrap change in Drive or GitHub and before asserting cross-store identity.

detector.signal: Cross-store identity claim lacks one shared digest/canonicalization receipt.
detector.threshold: Any identity claim beyond semantic alignment.
detector.false_positive: Representations intentionally differ in formatting while carrying the same substantive contract.
detector.false_negative: Unobserved Drive revision or GitHub blob changed outside the bounded read.
detector.evidence_needed: Current Drive revision, GitHub blob, exported bytes/canonicalized text and digests.

r3.F_ok: Drive revision identity and GitHub blob identity are now captured with scoped semantic alignment.
r3.F_next: Compute and compare canonicalized digests without rewriting either source.
